## Governance

This section sets out the governance disclosures required for oversight of sustainability-related risks and opportunities.

### Oversight by governance body(ies) or individual(s)

The governance body(ies) or individual(s) responsible for oversight of sustainability-related risks and opportunities have not been identified in this section.

Accordingly, this section does not describe:

- how responsibilities for sustainability-related risks and opportunities are reflected in terms of reference, mandates, role descriptions or related policies;
- how appropriate skills and competencies are determined or developed;
- how and how often the governance body(ies) or individual(s) is informed;
- how sustainability-related risks and opportunities are taken into account when overseeing strategy, major transactions and risk management processes (including consideration of trade-offs);
- how targets are overseen and progress monitored, including whether and how related performance metrics are included in remuneration policies.

### Management’s role

Management’s role in the governance processes, controls and procedures used to monitor, manage and oversee sustainability-related risks and opportunities has not been described in this section.

Accordingly, this section does not specify:

- whether the role is delegated to a specific management-level position or management-level committee, or how oversight is exercised; and
- whether management uses controls and procedures to support oversight of sustainability-related risks and opportunities, or how these are integrated with other internal functions.
